supervision_windows.evaluation: tick 10 one step; tick 15 predicted feedback and direct horizon; all within the same TRAIN episode

fit_policy.fit_input_rule: Only recorded real values and temporal increments at tick <= cutoff; model/causal_input.py indexes the TRAIN prefix once.
fit_policy.scale_semantics: Current forecast scale uses historical raw increment RMS; residual-scale calibration is subsequent work. Constant dimensions use an explicit model prior, never replacement truth.

leak_audit.future_truth: Dataset.world_model.data.windows.reject_future_truth_inputs rejects truth records with tick > cutoff AND input records whose provenance available_time.tick > cutoff
leak_audit.future_visibility_topology: Dataset.world_model.data.windows.audit_input_selector perturbs all future field content and requires selector membership to be unchanged; a flip is a future-visibility/topology leak and raises
leak_audit.split_authority: build_supervision_window resolves the episode's ORIGINAL source through configs/split-table.json and refuses caller splits that disagree (v2)

split_group_policy.rule: source_family and split_group derive from the ORIGINAL scenario/seed key <scenario>_v<N>__seed<M>; every old/new copy, 36overlay and normal/congested branch, and every supervision window built from one source shares exactly that original's single split group; versions are not independent examples
split_group_policy.table_source: configs/split-table.json; assignments retained from Dataset/world_model/runs/capture/cohort.json; build_supervision_window and model.load_index resolve the original source group.
split_group_policy.decorated_ids: variant marks after '::' or '++' are preserved verbatim and never create a new split group; TEST originals are not present in the old cohort and are not invented here
split_group_policy.unknown: any episode id outside the declared table raises SplitGroupError instead of guessing

six_point_supplement_policy.revisions: v14 PACKAGE source_revision is separate from per-dimension producer_revision; a 36x8 package label never proves all eight producers changed; per-dimension actual source files mapped in Dataset.world_model.data.provenance.package_revision_document (unprovided dimensions stay producer_revision=null)
six_point_supplement_policy.views: lossless archive view lives in archive.* families of the canonical records (address/archive-only by construction); model_visible_view and model_visible_typed_view admit only tick <= cutoff content and strip archive/terminal/hindsight-only material; known-plan experiments need separate labels
six_point_supplement_policy.transported_q: ORACLE_ONLY (TRUE future + TRAIN-frozen Gaussian noise), never a prediction input
six_point_supplement_policy.splits: ORIGINAL scenario+seed decides; all versions/overlays/load branches/windows share one split; new-scenario generalization claims require the ENTIRE scenario with all seeds held out
six_point_supplement_policy.lp_definitions: legacy q-based L/P (L/p01-legacy-q-bounded-observation) and native mature accepted-cohort TTL L/P (L/p01-ttl-observation-actual-available-time) are different definitions, never one metric under two cohorts; a case without a timely RX has L UNDEFINED (excluded and counted, never folded into the mean as zero)
